args.answer:
The Animal Haven’s dog-walker role has a published minimum age of 21, so at 15 you don’t meet that stated requirement. Your dad’s availability on weekends doesn’t change the age minimum. The application status is “confirm with organization,” not a confirmed opening.

A possible alternative is Dan Cosgrove Animal Shelter’s Tails to Trails off-site dog-walking program in Branford. No minimum age is published for that role; because you’re under 18, check whether minors can participate and whether a parent must attend. The shelter’s general orientation information mentions under-16s with a guardian, but it’s unclear if that applies to Tails to Trails. Its application status is also “confirm with organization,” and no specific shifts are listed. A $50 fee is published for volunteers who are not Branford residents.

You could ask the shelter whether you and your dad can participate, what the next orientation is, and whether the fee applies to you.
